Seeker +3: Provides a +3 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +3 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Underwater Action: This item grants the wearer the ability to breathe water as if it were air.
Saltmarsh Explorer: 5 Pieces Equipped:+5 Artifact bonus to PRR and MRR+1 Artifact bonus to all ability scores
Mythic Belt Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
